instructions.zh: 以专业产品讲解的方式说普通话。声音温和、清晰、稳重，语速稍快，节奏紧凑，咬字完整，像认真地向客户说明工具。重点轻微强调，句间自然停顿，音调变化克制。保持亲切感，不要闲聊腔，不要新闻播报腔，不要甜腻撒娇，不要拖长尾音。
instructions.en: Use a clear, warm, professional female voice. Speak natural conversational English at a moderately brisk pace, with short pauses. Calm, confident product walkthrough, without sales emphasis or sing-song intonation.

delivery.status: Final v5 release candidate: production paths, full bilingual playback, mobile guide and media integrity verified.

scenes.name: 01-stock
scenes.zh: 关注一只股票，公司事件和博主观点，Ducky 帮你持续整理。
scenes.en: Follow a stock. Ducky keeps its company events and creator views together, so you can keep up.

en: Ducky keeps its company events and creator views together,

scenes.name: 02-evidence
scenes.zh: 高管买入、超跌线索，按你的条件筛选。点开日期和原文，核对依据。
scenes.en: Screen for insider buying and oversold stocks using your own filters. Check the dates and original filings.

scenes.name: 03-creators
scenes.zh: 查看博主解读，点开时间点听原话。再看价格图表，回看后来的涨跌。
scenes.en: Read a creator summary and jump to the original video. Use the price chart to review what happened afterward.

scenes.name: 04-context
scenes.zh: 财报、休市和重要数据提前看，每日摘要再汇总与你股票有关的变化。
scenes.en: Check upcoming earnings, market holidays, and key releases. Your daily brief brings together updates related to your stocks.

scenes.name: 05-alerts
scenes.zh: 开启提醒，条件满足时通知你。先免费加一只股票，开始体验。
scenes.en: Set an alert and get notified when your conditions are met. Start free with one stock.
